name: io.github.sarvamai/sarvam-mcp
description: Official Sarvam AI MCP server — STT, TTS, Translate, Transliterate, LLM, Vision OCR for Indic languages

environment_variables.name: SARVAM_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Your Sarvam API key from dashboard.sarvam.ai

environment_variables.name: SARVAM_API_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Override API base URL for testing/staging. Defaults to https://api.sarvam.ai

environment_variables.name: SARVAM_MCP_BASE_PATH
environment_variables.description: Base path for file outputs. Defaults to ~/Desktop if not provided.
